children: Wacker Chemie said it plans to further reduce its stake in Siltronic through an accelerated bookbuilding process to strengthen its financial position.
The German chemical company said Tuesday it would sell around 2.2 million shares in the German manufacturer of semiconductor wafers, representing about 6.7% of Siltronic's outstanding shares.
Pricing and allocation are expected to take place shortly after the completion of the bookbuild, it said.
Wacker currently holds a 21.67% stake in Siltronic--down from 30.83% in May--and will remain a significant shareholder after completion of the transaction, it said.
